name: Salmon and spinach frittata
description: Eggs baked with flaked salmon, wilted spinach and softened onion, then cut into four portions.
instructions: Warm the olive oil in an ovenproof pan over a medium heat and soften the onion for 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the spinach a handful at a time and let it wilt, then spread it evenly across the pan.
Sear the salmon fillet for 3 to 4 minutes a side, then flake it into large pieces over the spinach.
Whisk the eggs until even, pour them over the pan and cook undisturbed until the edges set.
Finish in a low oven until the middle is just firm, then cut into four wedges and lift out one slice per serving.
